resolution_rules: A path is owned by the packet whose write_scope entry is the longest matching prefix in the same repo; identical entries in two packets are forbidden.
Frozen paths override every write scope: no packet writes them without the recorded change_authority.
Shared-resource paths are written only through the resource's integration_owner; other packets propose changes.
Pre-roadmap files outside every scope are integrator_owned (A01 integration owner); writing one requires a recorded packet scope revision first.
status 'real' means the path existed at baseline; 'proposed' paths are created by their owning packet.

frozen_paths.change_authority: PM dispatch change recorded on ALG-3086 before any write

schema-registry.rule: locked name@version is immutable; revisions register a new version; a version pinned by a queued packet cannot be removed (registry.check_lock_transition)

dependency-lockfiles.rule: packets propose dependency changes; only the owner edits and relocks

generated-clients.rule: none exist at baseline; any generated client is regenerated from the schema registry by the owner, never hand-edited

make-targets.rule: each packet proposes its verify-Axx/demo-Axx targets; the owner integrates

db-migrations.rule: single linear Alembic history; serialize merges; destructive migrations need release authorization

auth-contract.rule: tenant derives from identity; changes rerun cross-tenant denial tests

execution-contract.rule: intent->plan->reservation->command route; A08 proposes, A07 integrates

task-authority.rule: one coordinator; no second claimant of the same work

infrastructure-state.rule: vps-infra changes are serialized through A25; host .243 is off-limits to packet runs; carve_outs list the only other packets' write scopes inside these paths
